text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno was studying with her textbook, but she kept nodding off and jerking back awake.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp! I-I'm terribly sorry, Boss!
To fall asleep when I should be a model student..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'll go wash my face
and psych myself up all over again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno seems to be accumulating fatigue.
It might be necessary to review her schedule.
